name: Cone of Cold
description: Level 5 Evocation (Druid, Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: Self Components: V, S, M (a small crystal or glass cone) Duration: Instantaneous You unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Resolve saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.
